name: Claude Code

deny.note: Two channels: permissionDecision 'deny' and exit code 2. Honoured in the most permissive mode.

ask.note: Reaches a human when a human is there. In non-interactive mode (claude -p) a hook ask becomes a DENY. The README claimed an ask reaches you in every mode; probing showed otherwise.

onCrash.note: Measured: hook exits 1 with non-JSON stdout, the tool ran and permission_denials was empty.

onTimeout.note: Measured: timeout 2 against an 8s hook, the tool ran and the deny was discarded.

subagentSpawn.note: The model emits `Task`; the payload and matchers see `Agent`, because toolAliases resolves the name before hooks run.

firesOnFailure.note: A failed call fires PostToolUseFailure, which the installer does not register, so those calls never reach recordPost.

canModifyInput.note: updatedInput is supported upstream; LeastGrant does not use it.

modes.askSurvivesNote: Interactively. Non-interactive (-p) turns any hook ask into a deny regardless of mode.

upstreamLimitations: Managed policy `disableAllHooks: true` switches every hook off, including managed ones, with no signal LeastGrant can see. It is silently absent.
Fails open on crash and on timeout, so a LeastGrant that cannot start enforces nothing.
A hook ask in non-interactive mode is a deny, not a prompt.
The public docs list PreModelSwitch and PostModelSwitch, which do not exist in the installed 2.1.240 binary.
leastgrantLimitations: Only PreToolUse and PostToolUse are registered, so failed calls are never observed and their pending entries are never resolved.
Verified on Windows only. macOS and Linux run the same code path but nobody has driven the real binary there.

live.what: LeastGrant installed into a real Claude Code session; PreToolUse and PostToolUse observed firing, a credential read prompted, and a completed call recorded as evidence.

transport.what: The hook is invoked over native stdin with the settings.json command string; exercised by every hook test in the suite driving the real binary.

contract.what: Hook schema, permissionDecision values and mode list read from the shipped 337 MB bin/claude.exe bundle and cross-checked against code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.

mechanism: A `PreToolUse` and `PostToolUse` command hook in settings.json. The payload arrives on stdin; the verdict goes to stdout as `hookSpecificOutput`.
